## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Polyhedra
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Named solids as Conway programs on the seeds
//  - The remaining nine Catalan duals
//  - The expand, bevel and snub Archimedeans
//  - Dual, ambo and truncate on polygon meshes
//  - Expand, snub and bevel on polygon meshes
//  - Kis, join and needle on polygon meshes
//  - Ortho, meta and gyro on polygon meshes
//  - Chamfer, propeller, zip and reflect on polygon meshes
//  - Reading a polyhedron
//  - Polyhedral dual pairings on the solid kinds
//  - The five Platonic solids as polygon meshes

library Polyhedra
{
    //==
    // # Named solids as Conway programs on the seeds
    //
    // The Archimedean and Catalan solids this tree can name so far, each a one-line
    // Conway program over a Platonic seed
    // rather than another coordinate table. Read
    // as `PolygonMesh3D.Cuboctahedron`, `PolygonMesh3D.RhombicDodecahedron`, …
    //
    // This covers the ambo and truncate families and their duals. The expand,
    // bevel and snub families, and the remaining nine Catalan duals, follow in the
    // next two sections; together the three catalogs name all thirteen of each of
    // the `ArchimedeanSolid` / `CatalanSolid` sums in `solids.types.plato`.
    //
    // Vertices are NOT normalized to a common radius: the Archimedeans below are
    // vertex-transitive and may be passed through ProjectedToUnitSphere, the
    // Catalans must not be.

    //==
    // Archimedean — rectified seeds (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Archimedean_solid).

    // 8 triangles + 6 squares on 12 vertices
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuboctahedron).
    Cuboctahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.Cube.Ambo;

    // 20 triangles + 12 pentagons on 30 vertices
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Icosidodecahedron).
    Icosidodecahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.Dodecahedron.Ambo;

    //==
    // Archimedean — truncated seeds.

    // 4 triangles + 4 hexagons on 12 vertices
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truncated_tetrahedron).
    TruncatedTetrahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.Tetrahedron.Truncate;

    // 8 triangles + 6 octagons on 24 vertices
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truncated_cube).
    TruncatedCube(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.Cube.Truncate;

    // 6 squares + 8 hexagons on 24 vertices
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truncated_octahedron).
    TruncatedOctahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.Octahedron.Truncate;

    // 20 triangles + 12 decagons on 60 vertices
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truncated_dodecahedron).
    TruncatedDodecahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.Dodecahedron.Truncate;

    // 12 pentagons + 20 hexagons on 60 vertices: the football
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truncated_icosahedron).
    TruncatedIcosahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.Icosahedron.Truncate;

    //==
    // Catalan — duals of the above (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catalan_solid).
    // IFace-transitive, so their vertices sit at more than one radius.

    // 12 rhombi on 14 vertices: the dual of the cuboctahedron
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rhombic_dodecahedron).
    RhombicDodecahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.Cuboctahedron.Dual;

    // 30 rhombi on 32 vertices: the dual of the icosidodecahedron
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rhombic_triacontahedron).
    RhombicTriacontahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.Icosidodecahedron.Dual;

    // 12 isosceles triangles on 8 vertices: the dual of the truncated
    // tetrahedron (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triakis_tetrahedron).
    TriakisTetrahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.TruncatedTetrahedron.Dual;

    // 24 isosceles triangles on 14 vertices: the dual of the truncated cube
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triakis_octahedron).
    TriakisOctahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.TruncatedCube.Dual;

    //==
    // # The remaining nine Catalan duals
    //
    // The Catalan solids the base catalog could
    // not name, each simply the Conway `Dual` of
    // its Archimedean partner — the same pairing the duals section records on the
    // kind sums. Together with the base catalog's four this names
    // all thirteen Catalans (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catalan_solid).
    //
    // All are face-transitive, so their vertices sit at more than one radius: never
    // pass them through ProjectedToUnitSphere. The duals of the two snubs inherit
    // their source's chirality.

    // 24 isosceles triangles on 14 vertices: the dual of the truncated
    // octahedron (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tetrakis_hexahedron).
    TetrakisHexahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.TruncatedOctahedron.Dual;

    // 60 isosceles triangles on 32 vertices: the dual of the truncated
    // dodecahedron (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triakis_icosahedron).
    TriakisIcosahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.TruncatedDodecahedron.Dual;

    // 60 isosceles triangles on 32 vertices: the dual of the truncated
    // icosahedron (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pentakis_dodecahedron).
    PentakisDodecahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.TruncatedIcosahedron.Dual;

    // 24 kites on 26 vertices: the dual of the rhombicuboctahedron
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deltoidal_icositetrahedron).
    DeltoidalIcositetrahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.Rhombicuboctahedron.Dual;

    // 60 kites on 62 vertices: the dual of the rhombicosidodecahedron
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deltoidal_hexecontahedron).
    DeltoidalHexecontahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.Rhombicosidodecahedron.Dual;

    // 48 scalene triangles on 26 vertices: the dual of the truncated
    // cuboctahedron (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disdyakis_dodecahedron).
    DisdyakisDodecahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.TruncatedCuboctahedron.Dual;

    // 120 scalene triangles on 62 vertices: the dual of the truncated
    // icosidodecahedron (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disdyakis_triacontahedron).
    DisdyakisTriacontahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.TruncatedIcosidodecahedron.Dual;

    // 24 irregular pentagons on 38 vertices: the chiral dual of the snub cube
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pentagonal_icositetrahedron).
    PentagonalIcositetrahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.SnubCube.Dual;

    // 60 irregular pentagons on 92 vertices: the chiral dual of the snub
    // dodecahedron (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pentagonal_hexecontahedron).
    PentagonalHexecontahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.SnubDodecahedron.Dual;
```
